era: Dictionary.com 2019 (Arquivo captures Jan, Jul and Dec 2019 of the home page; Mar, Sep and Nov 2019 of word pages): grey top strip with the menu button and Dictionary.com / Thesaurus.com tabs, blue #3b77c5 header with the white Dictionary.com logo and a white search box, TRENDING ticker, article cards and a Word of the Day panel with SUBSCRIBE NOW. The 2019 menu held Everything After Z (featured articles), Word of the Day, Grammar, Crossword Solver / Daily Crossword, Slang, Emoji, Gender & Sexuality and Acronyms.
